prior_information: All V30 results known. Source column names, tariff unit frequencies and first 15 linked package descriptions inspected. New unit-question outcomes, policy comparisons, costs and rule perturbations not computed. This is an explicitly designed extension, not an independent preregistration.
question: Does a tariff-linked SL presentation explicitly document a strength numerator in the mass family required by a mass-denominated tariff?
population: Every V30 Swiss medication-tariff question in both snapshots; retain missing bridges, all ambiguous units and every package. Fixed keys.
rules: Numeric amount followed by g/mg/mcg/ug/µg is MASS, IU/UI/I.E./IE is ACTIVITY; standalone mL is VOLUME; incomplete or mixed non-mass strengths are unknown. Concentration numerators count as MASS without claiming total/administered dose. Tariff mg/g/mcg maps MASS; U/AN/UD remain uninterpreted. Generic U is not equated with IU. Exact token offsets and record hashes retained.
sensitivity: Report every candidate transition when concentration numerators are withheld; mass-prefix normalization disabled; generic tariff U is interpreted as activity (alternative assumption); witness aggregation made universal; Swiss route family projection or formulation restrictions substituted. All variants, not best subset.
comparators: Unchanged completion bounds vs unresolved-degree on all eligible mass/activity fields, 128 random orders, costs measured separately. Designed control: field A affects 3 questions each with another missing witness; field D affects 2 sole-witness questions. Exhaust all 4 singleton A/D actual assignments. Budget 1; nuisance witness remains unknown. Retain both policy wins and losses.
timing: Seven repeated warm-cache local runs; record PDF subprocess extraction per 13 documents, CSV full read/decode, and selector-only runtimes. Also allocation costs per source record from CSV measured scan (explicit equal-share proxy). No human-effort inference. Timing output observational; deterministic scientific outputs compared separately.
human_effort: Prepared randomized field-review form with start/end/active time, reused documents, success/unknown, analyst ID; actual human review pending. Never substitute machine milliseconds for human minutes.
acceptance: All questions, variants, costs and fixture assignments reported. Full independent SQL checks; kernel hash unchanged. No favorable-effect acceptance criterion.

adapter_correction.prior_information: Initial run inspected. Withholding concentration numerator incorrectly made container mL a negative strength witness. Corrected volume-only records to unknown; all initial outputs archived. Population, comparators, budgets and unit assumptions unchanged.
adapter_correction.reason: Container volume alone is not a complete active-strength field and cannot warrant conflict.

stronger_comparator_addendum.prior_information: Initial unit-task budget results known: raw degree prioritizes uninterpreted tariff units.
stronger_comparator_addendum.definition: Add exploratory interpreted-degree arm that counts only unresolved questions with nonempty fully interpreted options. Keep every original arm and budget. This tests whether simple semantic filtering explains the observed bound-versus-raw-degree difference.
